lines.text: My name is Helpi and I am here to advise you.
You can't see me because I speak you in thought.
Do you see the slab just under you ?
It's a magical slab connected to the others dimensions.
It will allow you to get new power during you travel thanks to the Atomiums you will find.
You already got the Alpha power.
Now you can move with the arrow keys.
To walk, press the up arrow.
If you want to turn, press the corresponding side arrow.
